name.pt-BR: Questões disputadas sobre a perfeição evangélica

description.la: Quattuor quaestiones disputatae de perfectione evangelica: de humilitate, paupertate, continentia, oboedientia; contra Gulielmum a S. Amore. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Opera omnia V, 1891), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: Four disputed questions on evangelical perfection (humility, poverty, chastity, obedience), Bonaventure’s Paris defence of the mendicant life against William of Saint-Amour. The text is the Quaracchi edition (Opera omnia V, 1891) from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Quatro questões disputadas sobre a perfeição evangélica (humildade, pobreza, castidade, obediência).

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Opera omnia, tom. V (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1891), pp. 117-198.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates) of the folio edition. Each page is read in two columns; marginal notes, running heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings, cross-references) and small-type scholia are removed by layout (line pitch and measure); line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1891 is public domain.
